as_told.title: Access to Cusco tunnels via head archaeologist

plain: A researcher who goes by Luke Caverns says he was inside tunnels under Saqsaywaman, an ancient stone site above Cusco in Peru, in September, months before they were officially announced. He says he got in through the head archaeologist at the site. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast to show the tunnels were known before the public was told.
